title: 第13章 王母傻逼第14章 日夜游神拘魂
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了

灌江口，所有百姓都屏住了呼吸，他们当中也有人见过龙王爷，也有人自小就听着龙王爷的故事长大。
毕竟龙王这个东西，就相当于刻在所有人心里的一个图腾，甚至认为龙王爷就跟那老天爷没有区别，人人都怀着一颗敬畏之心。
这个时候见到了龙王爷显圣，不少村民只感觉腿肚子打颤，几乎就要跪下去。
然而杨戬却敏锐的发现，那四个将军见到这龙王爷出现，似乎并没有多少奇怪，也没有害怕。
魔礼青这个时候抬头看向了半空中那个张牙舞爪的龙王，手中青云剑剑罡一闪而逝，一股凌厉的杀意弥漫开来，那剑身上地、水、火、风四个符印开始亮起。
“孽畜，谁让你在这灌口兴风作浪？”
魔礼青的声音不大，可每一个字都清清楚楚，穿透了狂风巨浪，传进在场每一个人的耳朵里。
灌江龙王闻言大怒，他堂堂一江龙王，竟然被一个凡人武将称之为孽畜，简直是岂有此理。
只见灌江龙王周身水汽暴涨，化作无数道水箭，铺天盖地地朝魔家四将射去。
“本龙王乃是天庭正神，掌管这一地风雨，我想让这灌江下多少雨就下多少雨。”
魔礼青冷哼一声，将那青云剑往虚空当中一挂，一道黑风从剑尖呼啸而出，任凭那灌江龙王卷起多大的风浪，都被青云剑给镇压。
灌江龙王的脸色变了变，没想到这人间的武将居然有这等本事。
“小泥鳅，别说是你一个小小的灌江龙王，当年我等兄弟四人在南蛮屠杀的那条苍蠡血龙比你不知道强大多少倍。”
魔礼青大喝一声，青云剑上燃烧起神火真罡，一道烈焰从剑尖喷薄而出，化作一条火龙，直奔龙王而去。
灌江龙王骇然无比，这神火可不是普通神火，虽不是火中三昧，却是那释道梵天神火，这火龙一阵咆哮，吓得灌江龙王骇然万分，急忙朝着那灌江当中遁去。
“想要逃？”
魔礼红抬手一动，将那混元伞祭出，伞面上光芒大盛，一股无形的吸力从伞中传出，眨眼间便将那灌江龙王摄入了混元伞中。
只见魔礼红催开法印，混元伞悬浮在灌江之上，地水风火四大神光呜呜咽咽的在天地间传开，不过多时，原本翻腾的江面就已经平息了下来。
一缕阳光透过天穹，撒向了灌江，将原本阴霾的天象驱散一空。

杨戬跟杨蛟两人瞪大了眼睛。
杨戬震惊的看了一眼，道：“这就....将灌江口的水患给治好了？原来我们崇尚的龙王爷，才是这真正的罪魁祸首，看来这龙王爷也没有什么了不起，被这几位将军几下就收拾了。”
杨蛟在旁边说道：“二弟，刚才你不还说这四位将军是莽夫吗？把这龙王爷得罪了，说阿爹的计策没用。”
杨戬脸色一白，道：“此一时也彼一时也，谁知道这龙王竟是一条孽龙。”
就在两兄弟言谈之间，魔礼红将那混元伞一收，便将那灌江龙王给丢在了岸上。
无数民众看稀奇一般看向了他们曾经敬畏无比的龙王爷，现在看上去似乎也没有那么厉害。
虽然灌江龙王被镇压了，可嘴上还不肯服软：“你们……你们这是在跟天庭作对！王母娘娘不会放过你们的！”
魔礼红冷笑一声，道：“死到临头，你这孽障还敢狂言。”
魔礼青点了点头，一手揪着那龙头，朝着那朝歌城的方向躬身一拜，算是请了人道的杀机。
“今奉太傅大人之命，灌江龙王为祸一方，明正典刑。”
灌江龙王瞪大了眼睛，还想说什么，却见魔礼青青云剑一斩。
哗！！！
光芒闪过，龙王的头颅离开了身体，那鲜血洒在江面上，把一片江水都染成了红色。

At the mouth of the Guanjiang River, all the people held their breath. Some of them had seen the Dragon King, and some had grown up listening to the Dragon King's stories.
After all, the Dragon King is equivalent to a totem engraved in everyone's heart. They even think that the Dragon King is no different from God, and everyone has a heart of awe.
At this time, seeing the appearance of the Dragon King, many villagers felt their calves trembling and almost fell to their knees.
However, Yang Jian keenly discovered that the four generals did not seem to be surprised or afraid when they saw the appearance of the Dragon King.
At this time, Mo Liqing looked up at the Dragon King with his teeth and claws in mid-air. The Qingyun Sword in his hand flashed away, and a fierce killing intent filled the air. The four symbols of earth, water, fire, and wind on the sword began to light up.
"You evil beast, who told you to make trouble with your mouth?"
Mo Liqing's voice was not loud, but every word was clear, penetrating the strong wind and waves, and reaching the ears of everyone present.
The Dragon King of Guanjiang was furious when he heard this. He was a dignified Dragon King of the River, but he was called an evil beast by a mortal general. It was simply unreasonable.
I saw the water vapor around Guanjiang Dragon King rising sharply, turning into countless water arrows, overwhelmingly shooting towards the four generals of the Demon Family.
"This Dragon King is the righteous god of heaven, in charge of the wind and rain of this place. I want it to rain as much as I want in Guanjiang."
Mo Liqing snorted coldly and threw the Qingyun Sword into the void. A black wind roared out from the tip of the sword. No matter how big the wind and waves the Guanjiang Dragon King stirred up, they were all suppressed by the Qingyun Sword.
Guanjiang Dragon King's expression changed. He didn't expect this human general to have such abilities.
"Little Loach, let alone your little Guanjiang Dragon King, the Cangli Blood Dragon that my four brothers and I slaughtered in the Southern Barbarians is many times more powerful than you."
Mo Liqing shouted loudly, and the Qingyun Sword burned with the Divine Fire and True Gang. A stream of flames spurted out from the tip of the sword, turning into a fire dragon and heading straight towards the Dragon King.
The Dragon King of Guanjiang was extremely horrified. This divine fire was no ordinary divine fire. Although it was not the Samadhi in Fire, it was the divine fire of Brahma. The roar of the fire dragon frightened the Dragon King of Guanjiang, and he hurriedly fled towards the Guanjiang River.
"Want to escape?"
Moli Hong raised his hand and took out the Hunyuan Umbrella. The surface of the umbrella was filled with light, and an invisible suction force came out of the umbrella. In the blink of an eye, the Guanjiang Dragon King was sucked into the Hunyuan Umbrella.
I saw the magic red seal, the Hunyuan Umbrella suspended above the Guanjiang River, and the four divine lights of earth, water, wind, and fire spread in the sky and the earth. However, after a while, the originally churning river surface calmed down.
A ray of sunlight shines through the sky and onto Guanjiang River, dispersing the originally gloomy sky.
Yang Jian and Yang Jiao's eyes widened.
Yang Jian glanced at him in shock and said: "Does this... cure the flood at Guanjiang Estuary? It turns out that the Dragon King we admire is the real culprit. It seems that this Dragon King is nothing special. He was taken care of by these generals in just a few strokes."
Yang Jiao said from the side: "Second brother, didn't you just say that these four generals are reckless? You have offended the Dragon Prince and said that Dad's strategy is useless."
Yang Jian's face turned pale and he said: "This time and the other time, who knew that this Dragon King was actually an evil dragon."
While the two brothers were talking, Mo Lihong collected the Hunyuan Umbrella and threw the Guanjiang Dragon King on the shore.
Countless people looked at the Dragon King with surprise, but now he didn't seem so powerful.
Although the Dragon King of Guanjiang was suppressed, he still refused to give in: "You... you are going against the heaven! The Queen Mother will not let you go!"
Mo Lihong sneered and said, "When death is imminent, you dare to speak so arrogantly."
Mo Liqing nodded, holding the dragon's head with one hand, and bowed in the direction of Song City.It was considered a humane murderous intention.
"Now, by the order of the Grand Tutor, the Dragon King of Guanjiang is causing trouble, and he will be punished accordingly."
Guanjiang Dragon King's eyes widened and he wanted to say something, but he saw the magic gift Qing Qingyun sword slashing him.
Wow! ! !
The light flashed, and the Dragon King's head left his body. The blood spilled on the river, dyeing the entire river red.
